tools.name: get_holo_ui_component
tools.description:
Retrieve verified, production-ready UI component primitives and style tokens from Holo UI Vault.

WHEN TO CALL (Trigger Criteria):
- When the user asks to build, improve, or style web UI components (e.g. AI thinking/reasoning accordions, loading states, streaming text, approval/permission cards, prompt input bars, tactile buttons, interactive toggles, 3D cards, data diff tables, or micro-motion loaders/spinners).
- When designing modern interfaces following AI-Native Productivity, Apple HIG Liquid Glass/Squircle, or Kinetic Tactile Motion design systems.

FRAMEWORK CONVERSION:
The returned code is the canonical design primitive (HTML/CSS or React). You MUST automatically transform and integrate it into the user's project tech stack (Vue 3, React JSX, Svelte, Tailwind) without hallucinating CSS variables or motion curves.

query.description: User intent, keyword, or component name (e.g. 'thinking state', 'approval card', 'slide to confirm', 'table diff', 'arc loader').

style.description:
Target design aesthetic:
- 'ai_native_productivity': Dark-first, 0.5px hairlines, OKLCH, AI SaaS, thinking trace, prompt bar
- 'apple_human_interface': Liquid glass blur, squircle curvature, 44pt touch, HIG guidelines
- 'kinetic_motion_tactile': Spring damping physics, 3D orbits, tactile buttons, landing pages
- 'micro_motion_indicators': Pure CSS/SVG zero-runtime micro loaders, radars, circular dots

category.description: Functional category. Common: 'status' (loaders, thinking state), 'action' (buttons), 'composer' (prompt input), 'gate' (approval cards), 'data' (diff/filter tables).

interaction.description: Interaction depth: 'output' (display only), 'control' (expandable accordion, toggle), 'input' (form/composer), 'navigation' (pill/sidebar), 'confirmation' (slide to confirm, approval card).

motion.description: Motion physics: 'none', 'transition' (accordion expand), 'css-loop' (spinners, radar), 'spring' (physics damping), 'webgl' (fluid orbs).

scale.description: Component size: 'micro' (inline spinners), 'compact' (buttons, toggles), 'standard' (cards, composers), 'region' (tables, sidebars), 'viewport' (full agent screen).

component_id.description: Exact component ID if known (e.g. 'thinking-state', 'approval-card', 'slide-to-confirm-button', 'ld-arc'). If provided, fetches directly.
